host: optional battlefield coordinator; independent image worker process
lifecycle: independent explicit start/stop; bounded private IPC; crash/timeout scoped to this worker; outbound sequences retained across worker restarts
input: actual decoded hero video frames; source timestamp; no server trajectory coordinates
output: local bounded temporal motion-pixel overlay; rm.situation/1 vision observation with optional normalized image_trail; original timestamp and 450ms TTL
limits: motion trails are not bullet classification; receiver cannot recover pixels lost before decoding; image-space track association requires camera compensation; no physical range or impact inference
data_policy: local display and explicitly authenticated team sharing only
